key_insight: After one chalcogen layer is removed, the remaining chalcogen—S or Se—primarily determines reconstruction, with only a minor influence from the parent lattice.
engineering_relevance: Chalcogen patterning could enable crystalline and disordered regions within a single depleted monolayer.
method: Ab initio MD of depleted MoS₂, MoSe₂, and Janus MoSSe derivatives.
Free in-plane cell simulations to resolve reconstruction and lattice contraction.
Reactive MD of 50 nm sheets and a lateral MoS₂/MoSe₂ heterostructure.
evidence_signal: Reactive MD shows Se-retaining sheets lose Mo crystalline order within 1 ps, with 36–39% of Se atoms crossing the Mo plane at every tested temperature, while S-retaining sheets preserve transient crystalline domains.
watch_item: The proposed patterning route remains simulation-based; experimental control of depletion and reconstruction requires validation.
paper_title: On the Spontaneous Structural Reconstructions of Chalcogen-Depleted MoS$_2$, MoSe$_2$, and Janus MoSSe Monolayers
